title: Usage Event
description: Trip-level telematics event emitted by the telematics-usage-ingestion service. Captures a single data point from an in-vehicle OBD-II / IoT device during a trip.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this telematics event.

vehicle_id.description: Identifier of the vehicle that produced the event.

trip_id.description: Identifier of the trip this event belongs to.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the event was recorded.

gps.description: GPS coordinates at the time of the event.

altitude_m.description: Altitude in metres above sea level (optional).

speed_kmh.description: Instantaneous speed in kilometres per hour.

acceleration_ms2.description: Longitudinal acceleration in m/s². Positive = accelerating, negative = decelerating.

braking_event.description: True if a hard-braking event was detected at this data point.
